My piece on the self-dealing of Trump during his second term has gotten a lot of traction, invited endless criticism and questions, and I thought I should respond to as much of it as possible. So, today, I published a follow-up piece answering those Qs and criticism.

Massive win for Rs, good outcome for democracy, bad outcome for Ds, and terrible outcome for Trump facing repercussions for his awful gerrymandering war.

We are in deep, deep trouble. 

A reader wrote in to me this week saying that they wouldn't read my Trump corruption story because ChatGPT "fact-checked the piece" and informed them most of it was false.

Among other things, ChatGPT told them that there is no Iran war, Jared Kushner is not a negotiator in the war, Qatar never offered Trump a $400 million plane, George Santos wasn't pardoned, the NYTimes did not report on Syrian billionaires lobbying Trump for sanctions relief, Trump never launch

The worst presidency for speech rights in the modern era. Not close.


Kyle Griffin (@kylegriffin1)
